stem:
During a school science exhibition, Meena explains human digestion to her classmates. Which of the following statements made by her is incorrect ( )
A. Digestion begins in the mouth, where food is chewed and mixed with saliva
B. Digestion breaks down complex food components like carbohydrates, proteins and fats into simpler forms
C. All digestion of food takes place only in the stomach
D. Digested food in simpler forms can be used by the body for energy and growth

options.text: Digestion begins in the mouth, where food is chewed and mixed with saliva
Digestion breaks down complex food components like carbohydrates, proteins and fats into simpler forms
All digestion of food takes place only in the stomach
Digested food in simpler forms can be used by the body for energy and growth

teacher.key_rationale: Digestion occurs along the entire alimentary canal from mouth to anus, not only in the stomach, so statement C is incorrect. A, B and D correctly describe digestion as the breakdown of complex food components into simpler usable forms.
